requirements.title: Fusion position drift is bounded relative to distance flown
requirements.description: While fusion is healthy, the stereo+IMU horizontal position shall end the flight within 10% of the distance travelled of PX4's estimate, and never exceed 20% once 20 m have been flown.
requirements.rationale: Dead-reckoning error that grows faster than distance flown makes the estimate unusable for guidance; it is the headline quality figure for visual-inertial odometry.
requirements.threshold: final drift <= 10% of path; peak drift <= 20% (>= 20 m flown)
requirements.measurement: Horizontal distance between the fused position and PX4's own estimate divided by PX4's cumulative path length, from the flight log (vv_harness.check_vo_drift). Reference is PX4's estimate, not ground truth.
requirements.known_open: Identical-configuration live flights K and L ended at 9.3% and 13.2% (peak 37%); the run-to-run spread is unexplained. See docs/engineering_results.md and bugs/BUG-018.md.

verification.detail: stereo_vo_flight_k:REQ-VO-DRIFT-01 PASS: final drift 9.3% over 78 m (error 7.31 m); peak 13.2%; stereo_vo_flight_l:REQ-VO-DRIFT-01 FAIL: final drift 13.2% over 78 m (error 10.23 m); peak 37.4%

requirements.title: Visual odometry is available while moving
requirements.description: Fusion shall be healthy in at least 80% of MOVE samples when the fusion node is running.
requirements.rationale: A localization source that is mostly stale cannot be relied on to close a control loop.
requirements.threshold: healthy in >= 80% of MOVE samples (healthy = accepted VO update within 0.5 s and fresh IMU)
requirements.measurement: Fraction of logged MOVE samples with vo_healthy=1 (vv_harness.check_vo_availability).
requirements.known_open: Live flights K and L reached 73% and 66%: about 5 VO updates/s under simulation load and VO losing track in fast yaw turns. See docs/engineering_results.md.

verification.detail: stereo_vo_flight_k:REQ-VO-AVAIL-01 FAIL: fusion healthy in 217/298 MOVE samples (73%); stereo_vo_flight_l:REQ-VO-AVAIL-01 FAIL: fusion healthy in 193/292 MOVE samples (66%)

requirements.title: A VO outage is detected and the dead-reckoned error stays bounded
requirements.description: When stereo VO stops delivering measurements, fusion health shall drop within 1 s, and the horizontal error shall grow by no more than 2 m over the baseline.
requirements.rationale: Consumers must be told the estimate is no longer vision-corrected, and IMU-only drift must stay small.
requirements.threshold: detect <= 1.0 s; error growth <= 2.0 m over the fault-free baseline (5 s outage)
requirements.measurement: Fault scenario vo_dropout_and_packet_loss fault 1: injected/observed/verdict record (faults/evidence.py).

verification.detail: vo_dropout_and_packet_loss#1:vo_dropout PASS: must_detect=True (limit True), detect_within_s=0.4 (limit 1.0), max_err_growth_m=0.118 (limit 2.0)

requirements.title: A frozen VO stream is rejected rather than trusted
requirements.description: A VO sensor that keeps repeating its last velocity shall be detected within 1 s with bounded error growth.
requirements.rationale: A stuck sensor is consistent with a state it is itself dragging along; trusting it silently caused an 11 m error (BUG-019).
requirements.threshold: detect <= 1.0 s; error growth <= 2.0 m; recovery <= 2.0 s
requirements.measurement: Fault scenario sensor_faults fault 8, plus unit tests of the stuck-measurement rule.

verification.detail: sensor_faults#8:frozen_sensor PASS: must_detect=True (limit True), detect_within_s=0.6 (limit 1.0), recover_within_s=0.0 (limit 2.0), max_err_growth_m=0.081 (limit 2.0)
no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Corrupted VO measurements are gated
requirements.description: Randomly spiked VO velocities (30% of samples, 20 m/s) shall not degrade the estimate by more than 2 m.
requirements.rationale: Stereo VO produces occasional absurd outputs on degenerate scenes; one accepted outlier ruins the state.
requirements.threshold: error growth <= 2.0 m; recovery <= 2.0 s
requirements.measurement: Fault scenario sensor_faults fault 6, plus gate unit tests.

verification.detail: sensor_faults#6:corrupted_measurement PASS: recover_within_s=0.0 (limit 2.0), max_err_growth_m=0.054 (limit 2.0)
no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: A frozen IMU is detected
requirements.description: An IMU that keeps repeating its first sample shall be detected within 1 s with bounded error growth.
requirements.rationale: Without VO the IMU is the only source, and a frozen accelerometer produced a 32 m error in the rig.
requirements.threshold: detect <= 1.0 s; error growth <= 1.0 m
requirements.measurement: Fault scenario imu_faults_during_vo_outage fault 4.
requirements.known_open: No frozen-IMU detector exists; false-positive rate cannot be measured without an IMU recording. bugs/BUG-020.md.

verification.detail: imu_faults_during_vo_outage#4:frozen_sensor FAIL: must_detect=True (limit True), detect_within_s=0.0 (limit 1.0), recover_within_s=15.0 (limit 25.0), max_err_growth_m=32.086 (limit 1.0)

requirements.title: The velocity PID loop stays inside its envelope
requirements.description: In velocity_pid mode the commanded velocity shall be finite and within 3.0 m/s horizontal and 1.5 m/s vertical.
requirements.rationale: The outer loop replaces position-setpoint steps that produced violent tilts; its bounds are the point of using it.
requirements.threshold: |v_xy| <= 3.0 m/s, |v_z| <= 1.5 m/s, finite, every velocity_pid sample
requirements.measurement: vv_harness.check_velocity_pid_envelope over the flight log, plus controller unit tests.

requirements.title: No loss of attitude control while airborne
requirements.description: Roll and pitch shall stay within 60 degrees in TAKEOFF, HOVER and MOVE.
requirements.rationale: Beyond that the vehicle is tumbling; the historical altitude "spike" (BUG-016) was this.
requirements.threshold: max(|roll|, |pitch|) <= 60 deg
requirements.measurement: vv_harness.check_attitude_envelope over the flight log.

requirements.title: The airframe keeps clear of mapped obstacles
requirements.description: Mapped clearance shall be positive throughout, and at least 0.35 m from the airframe centre to any obstacle surface.
requirements.rationale: Contact with an obstacle is the precursor to the loss-of-control failures seen in BUG-016.
requirements.threshold: min mapped clearance > 0 and >= 0.35 m
requirements.measurement: vv_harness.check_obstacle_clearance / check_airframe_contact over the flight log.

verification.detail: stereo_vo_flight_k:REQ-CLEARANCE-01 PASS: minimum mapped clearance 2.426m; stereo_vo_flight_k:REQ-CLEARANCE-02 PASS: minimum mapped clearance 2.426m (contact below 0.35m); stereo_vo_flight_l:REQ-CLEARANCE-01 PASS: minimum mapped clearance 2.413m; stereo_vo_flight_l:REQ-CLEARANCE-02 PASS: minimum mapped clearance 2.413m (contact below 0.35m)

requirements.title: The MAVLink v2 codec is byte-identical to the reference implementation
requirements.description: Frames this repository encodes shall equal pymavlink's byte for byte, and pymavlink's frames shall parse here.
requirements.rationale: A private codec is only trustworthy if it agrees with the reference on the wire.
requirements.threshold: 0 byte differences for HEARTBEAT, ATTITUDE, LOCAL_POSITION_NED, COMMAND_LONG, SET_POSITION_TARGET_LOCAL_NED; crc_extra table equal
requirements.measurement: Unit tests comparing encoded bytes with pymavlink.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Malformed input never produces a false frame and never stops the stream
requirements.description: Bad CRC, garbage, truncated, unknown-id and signed frames shall be counted and skipped, and the next good frame shall still parse.
requirements.rationale: A UART delivers noise; the parser must resynchronise rather than stall or fabricate data.
requirements.threshold: no exceptions; every malformed case counted; following good frame parsed; 200 random-noise chunks yield no frame
requirements.measurement: Parser and link unit tests (deterministic mock serial device).

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Link loss is detected and the link is re-established with bounded backoff
requirements.description: A disappearing transport shall be detected within 1 s, reconnect attempts shall back off and stop at a bound, and telemetry shall resume after the device returns.
requirements.rationale: A pulled cable or reset flight controller is routine on real vehicles.
requirements.threshold: detect <= 1.0 s; recover <= 4.0 s after the device returns; at most max_attempts opens per reconnect
requirements.measurement: Fault scenario link_faults fault 3 (comm_disconnect) and link unit tests.

verification.detail: link_faults#3:comm_disconnect PASS: must_detect=True (limit True), detect_within_s=0.05 (limit 1.0), recover_within_s=0.25 (limit 4.0)
no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Partial frame loss does not take the link down
requirements.description: With 30% of MAVLink frames lost the link shall stay alive and receive at least 40% of the nominal frame count.
requirements.rationale: Lossy radio links degrade; a supervisor that declares link-loss on mere degradation causes needless failsafes.
requirements.threshold: link alive throughout; rx ratio >= 0.40 of baseline
requirements.measurement: Fault scenario link_faults fault 1 (mavlink_packet_loss p=0.3).

verification.detail: link_faults#1:mavlink_packet_loss PASS: recover_within_s=0.0 (limit 1.5), must_stay_alive=True (limit True), min_rx_rate_ratio=0.737 (limit 0.4)

requirements.title: Timeouts, short writes and burst reads are handled
requirements.description: Reads shall time out cleanly, short writes shall be completed or reported, and a single poll shall drain everything already received.
requirements.rationale: A real defect found in this repository: a one-chunk-per-poll reader fell behind a 40 frame/s stream without bound.
requirements.threshold: no read hang; zero-progress write raises LinkDown; 30 queued frames drained by one poll
requirements.measurement: Unit tests on the deterministic clock and mock device.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Local NED containment uses a closed polygon
requirements.description: A finite local NED point shall be classified inside, outside, or on the boundary of the configured polygon. The boundary is closed. A self-intersecting polygon is an invalid configuration.
requirements.rationale: The keep-in is the permitted flight area for the whole sortie, not only the release volume.
requirements.threshold: on-boundary is inside; self-intersection is rejected
requirements.measurement: pytest geometry cases in test_mission_safety.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Invalid geofence configuration is rejected
requirements.description: The configuration shall be rejected when the polygon self-intersects, a coordinate is nonfinite, the frame is geographic, the altitude frame is missing, or the maximum altitude is below the minimum.
requirements.rationale: A bad keep-in must not be treated as an authorization to fly.
requirements.threshold: problems() is non-empty and evaluate returns invalid_configuration
requirements.measurement: pytest configuration cases in test_mission_safety.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Altitude frame and position uncertainty are explicit
requirements.description: Altitude shall be compared only in the configured frame. A position whose uncertainty reaches the boundary shall not be reported as unambiguously inside. A missing position is insufficient data.
requirements.rationale: Mixing AMSL with local height, or ignoring uncertainty, produces a false inside.
requirements.threshold: below and above limits denied; uncertain proximity is not inside
requirements.measurement: pytest altitude and uncertainty cases in test_mission_safety.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Short-horizon prediction is advisory
requirements.description: Constant-velocity prediction shall report a predicted crossing, a clear prediction, an uncertain prediction, or invalid velocity. The prediction alone shall not command a recovery maneuver.
requirements.rationale: The horizon has no acceleration and no wind. It is an advisory, not a certified safety case.
requirements.threshold: toward the boundary predicts a violation; away and stationary do not
requirements.measurement: pytest prediction cases in test_mission_safety.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Outgoing setpoints are admitted or rejected
requirements.description: Before publication, a position setpoint shall be inside the keep-in after the configured margin. Position mode may carry NaN velocity. A nonfinite position in position mode is rejected.
requirements.rationale: Checking only the current aircraft position would still publish a command that leaves the area.
requirements.threshold: outside setpoint rejected; finite position with NaN velocity admitted
requirements.measurement: pytest setpoint cases in test_mission_safety.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: A blocked return uses the documented fallback
requirements.description: A straight return whose segment leaves the keep-in shall be rejected. Descent below the cruise floor is allowed only inside the recovery polygon, down to the recovery minimum altitude.
requirements.rationale: Return-to-home is not safe when the segment crosses a notch in the permitted area.
requirements.threshold: notched segment reason is return_route_blocked; recovery floor is spatially scoped
requirements.measurement: pytest route and recovery-altitude cases in test_mission_safety.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: The keep-in covers every phase and the recovery marker
requirements.description: Geofence decisions shall be recorded during takeoff, transit, hold, dispensing, return, and precision landing. A marker whose NED position is outside the recovery polygon shall be rejected.
requirements.rationale: A valid detection can still name a landing point outside the permitted recovery area.
requirements.threshold: each of those states appears in geofence_decisions; marker_outside_recovery is recorded
requirements.measurement: pytest kinematic sortie in test_mission_safety.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: A denial during release closes the dispenser and leaves it closed
requirements.description: A weather, airspace, or altitude fault that starts after samples exist shall close the dispenser on the next evaluation. Samples already taken remain. A later healthy evaluation does not reopen it.
requirements.rationale: The release gate is sticky once the mission has aborted the dispense.
requirements.threshold: sample count frozen; altitude denial reason is estimated altitude invalid
requirements.measurement: pytest release-fault cases in test_mission_safety.py. Weather and airspace faults pass through the existing authorizers.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Position, offboard, dispenser, and duplicate faults are explicit
requirements.description: Invalid position shall not be reported as inside the keep-in and shall request PX4 land rather than a position hold. Offboard loss is recorded while the heartbeat continues. A dispenser fault is the simulated acknowledgement flag. Duplicate fault ids are rejected at plan construction.
requirements.rationale: A missing position cannot support a hold, and a simulated ack is not a physical dispenser sensor.
requirements.threshold: nav land on position loss; duplicate ids raise ValueError
requirements.measurement: pytest fault cases in test_mission_safety.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Flown SITL campaign reports match their scenario expectations
requirements.description: Each PX4 SITL report written by the mission verification campaign shall meet the expectation for its scenario. Runs that were not started are not verified. A unit test does not satisfy this requirement.
requirements.rationale: The campaign is the evidence that the integrated system, not only the kinematic plant, responded.
requirements.threshold: campaign_results.json exists and passed is true only when every written report met its expectation
requirements.measurement: scripts/run_mission_verification_campaign.sh writes evidence/mission_verification/*/sitl_report.json and campaign_summary.json. campaign_results.json is written only when every flown report met its expectation. A miss leaves that file absent, so this check is NOT_RUN and is not verified. CI has no PX4 SITL.

verification.detail: not run -- Needs a running PX4 SITL; not available on CI runners.

requirements.title: PX4 startup uses the current process, not a stale log
requirements.description: A PX4 log that already contains the startup success line shall not count as a fresh simulator start. The success line counts only when the log was written at or after launch and the recorded process is alive. MAVSDK connection and a fresh telemetry sample are separate states.
requirements.rationale: A leftover log from an earlier run made the launcher treat a new process as already started.
requirements.threshold: stale log is NOT_STARTED; live process with a fresh success line is READY; dead process is FAILED
requirements.measurement: pytest src/px4_offboard/test/test_abort_recovery.py startup cases.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Recovery descent may cross the recovery floor by the land-detector lag
requirements.description: A downward velocity whose current and predicted horizontal positions stay inside the recovery polygon shall remain admissible while altitude is within 1 m below the recovery floor. A deeper descent, a climb out, or a prediction that leaves the recovery polygon shall still be rejected. This does not lower the cruise floor.
requirements.rationale: PX4 can sit slightly below the local origin before it reports landed. Treating that as a geofence exit aborted a recovery that had already reached the marker.
requirements.threshold: altitude -0.4 m with a 0.6 m/s descent inside recovery is admitted; altitude -3 m is rejected
requirements.measurement: pytest touchdown-lag cases in test_abort_recovery.py.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass

requirements.title: Release denial and aircraft recovery are separate results
requirements.description: Evidence shall record release authorization, mission execution, and aircraft recovery independently. A denied release that then lands is a denied release and a landed recovery. A marker failure during descent is marker_lost_during_descent, not a generic landing failure. A marker jump beyond the acceptance threshold shall not refresh the fix timestamp. The 5 s marker timeout is unchanged.
requirements.rationale: A correct release interlock was being reported as if it described the landing.
requirements.threshold: denied release plus aborted mission state reports recovery landed; a jump does not refresh the fix
requirements.measurement: pytest outcome and marker-jump cases in test_abort_recovery.py and the orchestrator marker-loss case.

verification.detail: no test did anything other than pass
